meta.description: Review a code diff against docs/current_task.xml acceptance criteria, docs/context.xml, and docs/Purpose.xml. Outputs APPROVED or BLOCKED with severity-tagged issues.
meta.trigger_phrases: review this, check the diff, validate the changes, is this ready to merge, review the PR, check for issues, approve this

steps.step: Read: docs/current_task.xml — acceptance criteria, scope list, known facts docs/context.xml — API contracts, schema, env vars docs/Purpose.xml — architectural invariants The diff — from engineer or git diff output
List every file in the diff. Cross-reference against docs/current_task.xml files_in_scope. Any file in diff NOT in scope — BLOCK: scope_violation [file].

Scan diff for: - Endpoints not in docs/context.xml api_contracts - Env vars not in docs/context.xml environment_variables - DB columns or tables not in docs/context.xml database_schema - Types not in src/lib/types or docs/context.xml Any match — BLOCK: invented_behavior [item].
For each acceptance criterion in docs/current_task.xml: Mark: SATISFIED | PARTIAL | MISSING Cite the specific diff hunk, or note its absence.

step.name: correctness_check
step.check: Silent failure paths with no typed response.

step.name: docs_check
step.check: New endpoint — docs/context.xml api_contracts needs update.
New env var — docs/context.xml environment_variables needs update.
Schema change — docs/context.xml database_schema needs update.
New fragile area — docs/context.xml fragile_areas needs update.

steps.step:
Output this exact structure:
VERDICT: APPROVED | BLOCKED
Issues: [BLOCK|WARN|NOTE] file:line — description
Acceptance criteria: [SATISFIED|PARTIAL|MISSING] criterion — hunk ref or "not found"
Docs drift: docs/context.xml field needing update, or "none"
If BLOCKED: list exact changes required before re-review.

severity.level: Correctness bug, security risk, scope violation, invented behavior, missing critical error handling. Must resolve before merge.
Missing test, docs drift, weak error handling. Should resolve.
Style, naming, minor readability. Never blocking.

never.item: Approve a diff with invented APIs, env vars, or schema.
Approve a diff with undeclared out-of-scope file changes.

escalation.path: Switch to orchestrator. Surface all BLOCK issues with file:line references. Orchestrator updates docs/current_task.xml and re-dispatches the implementer.
Orchestrator updates docs/context.xml with stale fields before merge proceeds.
Orchestrator appends to docs/task-history.xml and resets docs/current_task.xml.
